Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Model

Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Model.GameModel
public class GameModel extends Object
The GameModel class represents the main model for the game, managing players, decks of cards, and the overall state of the game.
